title: Can LLMs Resolve Entity Conflicts in Domain Specific NLU Pipelines?
abstract: arXiv:2611.25733v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Resolving entity conflicts is a critical step in Pipeline-based NLU architectures, especially when multiple extractors provide overlapping or conflicting outputs. Traditional rule-based entity conflict resolution methods often lack flexibility and are unscalable. In this work, we aim to study if the broad knowledge of LLMs can be leveraged to resolve entity conflicts in domain specific NLU pipelines. We present an experimental comparison between a traditional rule-based conflict resolution method, and two LLM-based approaches: a multi-shot prompting method using the Llama3.1-8B-Instruct model and a LoRA fine-tuned Llama3.1-8B-Instruct model. The evaluation was conducted under two setups: (1) a broad assessment of LLM's capability to match existing NLU pipeline output, and (2) a more controlled scenario assessing the LLM accuracy on human-labeled data. translated_title: 大语言模型能否解决领域特定自然语言理解流水线中的实体冲突？
translated_abstract: 解决实体冲突是基于流水线的自然语言理解（NLU）架构中的一个关键步骤，尤其是当多个提取器提供重叠或冲突的输出时。传统的基于规则的实体冲突解决方法往往缺乏灵活性且难以扩展。在这项工作中，我们旨在研究是否可以利用大语言模型的广泛知识来解决领域特定NLU流水线中的实体冲突。我们对传统的基于规则的冲突解决方法与两种基于大语言模型的方法进行了实验比较：一种是使用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct模型的多轮提示方法，另一种是经过LoRA微调的Llama3.1-8B-Instruct模型。评估在两种设置下进行：（1）对大语言模型匹配现有NLU流水线输出的能力进行广泛评估；（2）在更受控的场景中评估大语言模型在人工标注数据上的准确率。结果表明，虽然多轮提示具有易于适配和行为快速调整的优势……
tldr: 本研究通过比较基于规则的冲突解决方法与两种基于大语言模型的方法（多轮提示和LoRA微调的Llama3.1-8B-Instruct），验证了大语言模型在解决领域特定NLU流水线中实体冲突问题上的可行性。
en_tdlr: This study validates the feasibility of using LLMs to resolve entity conflicts in domain-specific NLU pipelines by comparing rule-based conflict resolution with two LLM-based approaches: multi-shot prompting and LoRA fine-tuned Llama3.1-8B-Instruct.
